text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer-san!
Wait, are you really sure I can have this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll treasure it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Carrots grown in the same field,"
I'll introduce you to Ardan when we get back to the room!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let's all do our best together
starting today!
